# Dao Dao Resource Sharing Self-Directed Learning Website Privacy Policy

The mission of Dao Dao is to cultivate lifelong learning capabilities by promoting self-directed learning, enabling learners to exchange real learning experiences, discover and share valuable learning resources, and build connections with like-minded individuals. This Privacy Policy applies to any registered users or visitors of our services. Our registered users (“Members”) share their learning experiences and resources, engage in learning exchange activities with other members, showcase their personal skills, experiences, and growth, publish and view relevant content, and seek potential opportunities for mutual growth and collaboration. Non-registered users (“Visitors”) may view certain content and information provided by our services.

This Privacy Policy exists between you and the managing authority of the Dao Dao Resource Sharing Self-Directed Learning Website ([https://www.daoedu.tw](https://www.daoedu.tw), hereinafter referred to as “this Website”) (“Administrator”). Please read the following terms and conditions carefully and confirm that by uploading content to this Website, you agree to the contents of this policy.

## 1. Personal Data

1. After a member logs in, the Dao Dao learning community website will obtain the member’s Google information, including: email address and application user ID, for the purpose of distinguishing different accounts and contacting members. Public display information such as display name and profile picture will be used as the default avatar and display name on the Dao Dao learning community website.

2. Public information generated after a member logs in—such as newly added resources, partner-finding and group-organizing public data, response content, and frequency of platform usage—may be used by the Dao Dao team for data analysis. After undergoing processes such as quantification or de-identification and being detached from original personal identifiers, such data may be retained in open research or statistical datasets with names removed.

3. This Website will strictly protect members’ privacy and personal data. Except for data that has been sufficiently quantified or de-identified and is no longer considered personal data, such information will not be disclosed to third parties unrelated to this service for any purpose.

4. Members may directly change their default avatar and display name on the Dao Dao website via their personal page so that it no longer matches the public information from Facebook, Twitter, GitHub, or Google. In addition, members may email the Website’s contact address ([contact@daoedu.tw](mailto:contact@daoedu.tw)) to request deletion or replacement of public display information or email addresses obtained from platforms such as Google, Facebook, or GitHub.

5. After confirming receipt of the request, the Website will, within a maximum of thirty (30) days, verify that the sender’s email address is correct and sufficient to prove that the applicant is the original data subject, and then proceed with deletion or replacement.

6. When you register an account, we may ask you to provide relevant information such as your educational background, work experience, skills, photos, city, or region. You are not required to provide additional information in your personal profile; however, providing personal profile information may help us offer you more services. You may choose whether to include sensitive information in your profile and whether to make such sensitive information public. Please do not publish or add personal data in your profile that you do not wish to make public.

## 2. Embedded Content from Third-Party Websites

1. Articles on this Website may include embedded content such as videos, images, or articles. Embedded content from third-party websites follows the same privacy practices as if the user were visiting those websites directly. Regardless of whether users have accounts on those third-party websites or are logged in, such sites may collect and use user data in various ways, including through cookies, embedded third-party tracking code, and monitoring user interactions with the embedded content.

## 3. User Data Analysis

1. If you request a password reset, the IP address from which you are currently connecting will be displayed in the password reset email.

## 4. Retention Period of Personal Data on This Website

1. When a user posts a comment on this Website, the comment and its metadata will be retained indefinitely. This allows the system to automatically recognize and approve any follow-up comments without holding them in a moderation queue.

2. For users who register on this Website, the Website also stores the personal information they provide on the user “Profile” page. All users can view, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except for usernames, which cannot be changed). Please note that website administrators can also view and edit this personal information.

## 5. Rights of Users Regarding Their Personal Data

1. If a user has an account on this Website or has posted comments, the user may request an exported file of their personal data from this Website. This file will include all personal data that the user has provided to this Website.

2. Users may also request the erasure of all personal data they have provided to this Website; however, this request does not include data that the Website is required to retain for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

# Dao Dao Resource Sharing Self-Directed Learning Website Terms of Service

The mission of Dao Dao is to cultivate lifelong learning capabilities through promoting self-directed learning. Our services are dedicated to creating a trustworthy learning ecosystem where learners can exchange real learning experiences, discover and share valuable learning resources, and build connections with like-minded individuals. Through self-exploration, collaboration, and growth, learners can fully realize their potential and continue to thrive in a rapidly changing world.

These Terms of Service govern the use of all features of the Dao Dao Resource Sharing Self-Directed Learning Website ([https://www.daoedu.tw](https://www.daoedu.tw), hereinafter referred to as “this Website”), including searching for and adding resources, partner matching, group activities, and blogs. These Terms apply to any registered users or visitors of our services.

This service is available only to natural persons and is effective only for natural persons.

## 1. Members and Visitors

1. When you register and join this Website, you become a Member. If you choose not to register, you may access certain features as a “Visitor.” This Website is open to all, with no restrictions on eligibility to write verified responses.

## 2. Registration and Account Use

Regarding the registration and use of Dao Dao member accounts, you represent and warrant the following:

1. Users of this Website must be at least 16 years old. By completing registration or beginning to use the service, you are deemed to have fully reviewed, understood, and agreed to these Terms and to your registration as a member and use of the services.

2. You agree that all expressions of intent and content related to the service shall be expressed in electronic form, and that all notices from this Website will be delivered via email or other electronic means.

3. All information you provide during registration, including your real name and other required data, is current and accurate, and you will promptly update it if there are any changes.

4. You are not registering an account on behalf of another person.

5. You have not registered and will not register more than one personal account.

6. If your account is suspended, you will not register another account.

7. You understand and agree that any actions taken using your account on Dao Dao are deemed to be performed by you or with your authorization, and you may bear corresponding legal responsibility. Therefore, you will not allow others to use your account or disclose your account password to others.

8. You understand and agree that Dao Dao is an open platform where all public pages may be freely viewed. When publishing articles, responses, or communicating with other users, you should be aware that the information you disclose may allow strangers or acquaintances to identify your real identity, potentially impacting your real-life circumstances.

9. You understand and agree to fully disclose all necessary and truthful information regarding activities initiated on this Website, including but not limited to the purpose, content, requirements, and potential costs of such activities.

10. You understand and agree to receive periodic newsletters from this Website after registering as a member, and you may unsubscribe at any time.

11. Website services are available only to natural persons, and automated operations are prohibited. Except for known non-commercial third-party public service crawlers operating at low frequency and partial content capture (such as Internet Archive, Google, Facebook), automated crawling of Website content is prohibited.

## 3. Rights and Restrictions

Between you and this Website, you own the content and information you submit or publish to the service, and you grant us only the following non-exclusive license:

A worldwide, transferable, and sublicensable right to use, copy, modify, distribute, publish, and process the information and content you provide through our services or others’ services, without further consent, notice, or compensation to you or others. These rights are subject to the following limitations:

1. You may terminate the license for specific content by deleting it from the service or generally by closing your account, except where (a) you shared the content with others as part of the service and they copied, reshared, or stored it, or (b) reasonable time is required to remove it from backup and other systems.

2. If we intend to grant others the right to publish your content outside the service, we will obtain your consent.

3. While we may edit or change the format of your content (such as translating or transcribing, resizing, changing layout or file type, or removing metadata), we will not alter the meaning of your expression.

4. After logging in, members may contribute data by writing responses, evaluating existing responses, or supplementing additional information. Members should apply fact-checking methods when writing responses, providing verifiable objective facts and offering differing viewpoints where subjective opinions are involved.

5. Since you own your content and information and we only hold non-exclusive rights, you may choose to make it available to others, including under Creative Commons licenses.

## 4. Data Dispute Complaints

1. This Website does not proactively intervene in disputes regarding responses. Anyone may directly respond via the Website, and multiple responses to a single message are welcome.

2. If there are disputes regarding existing response content that require other forms of resolution, please contact this Website via email.

3. Complaint emails must clearly include the complainant’s real name and identity, the disputed response or message, the time and place of the dispute, and the reason for the complaint. This Website will attempt to contact the relevant member for assistance or add a new response to the message.

4. If a member’s response involves insults, defamation, dissemination of false information, copyright infringement, or other violations of laws or rights of others, this Website may delete the response and record the handling information in the [Data Dispute Handling Record](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1thhT7XFfMN9HNUEjTt68ytzh-jrjGQNgnRHR2K91QGk).
